rationale: HXL is sitting at 85.6% of today's range after a -12.77% gap-down on earnings disappointment, with price near the 9-EMA ($81.81) and showing slight consolidation in the last few candles — no clear directional momentum. With only 27 minutes to close, the risk of a late-day reversal or continuation is roughly symmetric, the ATR is small relative to the spread between current price and meaningful levels, and the broad market is under pressure (SPY -1.32%, VIXY +6.13%), making a long risky while the stock has already absorbed most of the gap-down selling, making a short equally uncertain. The reward/risk profile does not justify a position this late in the session.
